headline: Microsoft offers buyouts to 60,000 employees amid AI cost push
summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its global workforce, in the US, Canada, India and the UK, as it works to cut costs amid rising AI spending.
